Disdain for customers
Apr 2024 • Family
Please advise Hoang Tam not to look down on customers because they have to force them to eat the wrong food???
Today, April 29, 2024, my family and I went to eat at Hoang Tam Toa Park 1, Vinhom Tan Cang Area, Ward 22, Binh Thanh District, Ho Chi Minh City
When we came to order food, we were surprised because this was not the first time, but the 3-4 times we have come here, the attitude is like "forcing customers" to eat the wrong type of food! Specifically:
1. If you order braised fish rice and sour soup, can you say you don't have white rice and then force yourself to eat fried rice?
2. Eat beef vermicelli: small vermicelli (used to eat vermicelli noodles or grilled meat vermicelli...), not large vermicelli used for beef vermicelli!
It's better to say that if you finish the dish, you can order something else, then it's temporarily acceptable. There's no logic to this reason?
We were frustrated to see the manager, but there was no one, only the assistant gave a vague explanation, while we didn't talk to the staff because we've been here so many times that something like this happened, so we needed to see the manager and ask why and then said no. There is a manager but there is an assistant, the assistant passes by and sees the gdinh asking the employee. In fact, he sees an assistant coming to explain but doesn't bother, so we ask for a responsible person to ask. reason too. What if you eat something that doesn't match the dish? (Because there are many things that need to be said: - Number 1, there's a lot in Vinhom Sieu. Second, no matter what you cook, you've already used up the amount of soup but the noodles are out of water? If you don't have white rice and fried rice, then why use fried rice?
Very disrespectful to customers, it's not like we eat a little but come in and do the hard work and do the easy thing or this or that?
I hope customers review before eating and Hoang Tam serves, so does he have to force customers to eat leftovers?

Nice family dinner for out of towners...
Apr 2023 • Family
Decor is nice. Air Conditioned and clean. Service was quick and friendly. We ordered the bánh xèo (pancake) which I found was not crisp but it had nice flavours. Bánh khọt (mini pancake) was soggy, but the shrimp was bigger than usual for this dish. Various meats was tasty to wrap up in bánh tráng (rice paper). Loved the bò lá lốt (betel leaf beef). If you're game, try the anchovi dipping sauce (mắm nêm). Overall nice place to take the family out for dinner. Oh you gotta try the sour Cóc ép (ambarella) with sí mụi.

Good Vietnamese Food
Feb 2023 • Friends
Came by after flying in from Danang. We ordered various items. I, myself, ordered 2 lunch specials, the CÁNH GÀ XÓC NƯỚC MẮM and the BỎ XÀO CỦ HÀNH SỐT HOÀN 3 TÂM. Our food came out timely and at the right temperature. My lunch portions were very good. I liked both of them. The wings were the best I've had on this trip after 4 tries I wish they were a little more crispy. The accompanying rice was flavorful and the vegetable had a nice crunch. I didn't have much of the other items that were ordered but my friends said they were good. Take note that they charge you if you use their wet naps. Strange but I guess a lot of restaurants in Vietnam do this. Service was good. Place has A/C. Yea.

Passable banh mi and noodle dishes for Winhomes tenants
Apr 2018 • Family
While staying at a Winhomes condo for a couple of nights, we tried the banh mi downstairs in the nearby food court at Winhomes Central Parks. The sandwiches had prices reflecting the higher rent of the business area, and were very skimpy on meat contents - you'd have to order double meat here to get a "typical" Vietnamese banh mi sandwich. The noodle dishes were no better - bland, reflecting shallow flavoring usually resulting from too-few seasonings and hastened simmering to blend flavors. A disappointment in taste and value that we did not return to.
